owner_report.levels_1_to_9: work well; anything louder than 9 would likely degrade the audio
owner_report.tone_sweep: 5 T0 < T16 < T24 < T28 increasing loudness; T34 noticeably quieter; at T37 the sound cut out entirely and further cycles needed a battery pull

reading.tone: the driver tone value behaves like an output gain index for sample playback, rising to about 28-31 and failing above; 31 (used by this engine and upstream) is at or near the usable top
reading.digital: level 9 (x4) is the practical digital ceiling
reading.hazard: tone values above 31 are unsafe for sample playback: 37 stopped audio until a battery pull. The release module keeps tone fixed at 31; the lab build must not be used further
